scope: Family-specific exploratory solver-stage comparison. Different curve/interface from WDSat; this is not the broad 60-input repetition gate or a full-DLP experiment.
inputs: All 16 frozen predecessor targets plus eight fresh holdouts: uniform and supported at each n18/n30, prefix d8/d9. Identical curve, support, targets and m=3 exclusions for every variant.
hypothesis: The coefficient circuit is quadratic in coordinates of the affine admissible-b space. Interpolate it from 1+k+k(k-1)/2 evaluations, materialize all circuits by binary additions, and keep the predecessor search order and rejection rule. A second variant independently adds batch inversion of nonzero b values.
accounting: All table construction, interpolation, materialization, coefficient inversions, rank tests, failed work, extraction and exact verification charged. Field API add/mul/square and selected binary word work kept separate. Retained table field slots reported; total allocator/RSS peak remains unmeasured. Cooperative deadline overruns flagged. No calibrated total-cost ratio.
validation: Replay predecessor exhaustive GF64 triple checks; check both candidates on all 159 tiny target/space pairs. Compare every interpolated tiny-table entry against direct construction for selected targets and fresh larger samples. Independently audit every relation and block-rejection certificate, complete-set equality and source/input hashes.
falsification: Any incorrect interpolated circuit, false rejection, missing complete relation or invalid signed sum invalidates correctness. Construction reuse is not a scaling gain if saved multiplication work is offset by table, binary or elimination work. Retain first-hit regressions caused by precomputing the table.
followup: One frozen eight-target n30 d8 batch from blocks_01 is rerun with both candidates, the unchanged pruned reference and direct S3, sharing only declared setup. This is needed to compare against the stronger amortized baseline; fresh holdouts are in the cold corpus. No further size/budget expansion in this round.
boundary: The signed-triple yield ceiling is unchanged. Prior constructor floor is 530432 multiplications on the eight-target batch versus 207401 measured total S3 multiplications. That floor applies to direct construction; derive a new actual-work ledger after reuse. Multiplication-only wins cannot meet the calibrated three-size goal.
